implementation.scopeBoundary: Only the Search bounded-multiline framing seam, diagnostics, scanner/source plumbing, focused tests and regex-backend documentation changed. The existing unframed compatibility path, public two-argument Search source shape, SQL engine, sibling repositories and publication state were not changed.
implementation.framing: SearchRecordFraming validates bounded start/end delimiters and optional EOF behavior. SearchRecordFramer recognizes exact ordinal whole physical lines, ignores text outside records, excludes structural delimiter lines from payload and rejects unexpected ends, nested starts and strict unterminated EOF.
implementation.recordIdentity: Each emitted SearchRecordFrame carries an origin, record index, UTF-16 payload start/end-exclusive offsets, first physical line, payload text, optional mapped coordinates, optional byte range and explicit termination state.
implementation.boundsAndOwnership: Payload bytes remain bounded by the existing maximum-record budget; delimiter lengths and physical lines are bounded; cancellation is checked during reads, framing and matching; frame content and coordinates are owned allocations and no pooled scanner memory escapes.
implementation.compatibility: Legacy BoundedMultiline requests without framing retain the previous whole-input behavior, while record framing remains an internal regex request/scanner seam pending a separately specified public SQL surface.

newScenarios: Start and end delimiters split across reader buffers still frame records
Delimiter-like text inside a payload line remains payload
Each frame exposes origin, payload range, first physical line and termination
Missing end delimiter is rejected by default
An explicitly allowed unterminated EOF record is evaluated
Payload beyond the maximum record-byte budget is rejected
Mapped source byte coordinates survive structural delimiter removal
An existential sink stop prevents scanning later framed records

The separate ownership review approved explicit framing, bounded payloads, source coordinates, malformed-frame diagnostics, cancellation and existential sink-stop propagation; exact commands, tool versions, source/artifact hashes and the unique trailer-bearing completion commit are retained.

Framed regex matches retain global UTF-16 source offsets, physical line numbers and mapped byte ranges while structural delimiter lines remain outside the logical payload; the focused suite covers multiple records and EOF behavior.
The existing Search schema and two-argument SQL constructors remain unchanged; the Search Release suite and warnings-as-errors production build cover compatibility and compilation.
Framing rejects malformed nesting/unexpected end and strict unterminated EOF with a stable syntax diagnostic, enforces delimiter and payload budgets, and retains an explicit allowed-EOF result state.

knownLimitations: Framing recognizes exact whole physical-line delimiters only and ignores text outside framed records; delimiter-like substrings are not structural boundaries.
The framing seam is internal and does not add a new public SQL constructor argument or expose record fields in the Search row schema.
Injected custom readers have no observable physical byte identity; mapped byte ranges are retained only when the reader supplies coordinates.
